Re-run the tests that cover your change and report them in your fix report, appended to `.sdd/8-tide-height-format/task-3-report.md`. The change is in `tides/format.py`, so the covering tests are `tests/test_format.py` and every suite that imports `tides.format`: `core` and `export`. `export` is included because every test in it formats heights. `sync` imports only `tides.stations`, so it is not needed.

From the repo root, run:

```
uv run python build/run_suites.py core
uv run python build/run_suites.py export
```

In the fix report, include:
- what changed, with the file and line
- the exact commands you ran
- the full output of each run

The last line of each suite's output must read `suite runs passed`. If it does not, report that line as it appears and do not claim the fix is verified.

Before you edit, confirm that `round_height` in `tides/format.py` is where the finding applies. The brief requires rounding to 0.01 m, so the call must be `round(value, 2)`. Your round 1 fix changed a different line and the finding reopened. Name the line you changed this round.
